parameters.name: AccessType
parameters.description:
The access type of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **share** (default): CNAME access.

- **hybrid\_cloud\_cname**: hybrid cloud CNAME access.

> If the value is **share**, or the value is **hybrid\_cloud\_cname** and public cloud disaster recovery is enabled, call the [DescribeVerifyContent](~~2985193~~) and [VerifyDomainOwner](~~2985192~~) operations to verify domain name ownership first. If the domain name is connected to a region in the Chinese mainland, ICP filing must be completed.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.
